mechanism: Bumetanide (loop diuretic) causes volume depletion and electrolyte loss, which potentiates telmisartan's (ARB) hypotensive effects and increases risk of hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury, and syncope.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes regularly; educate patient on orthostatic precautions; adjust diuretic dose if hypotension occurs; ensure adequate hydration.
